the parish office will close on a wednesday at 2pm until further notice . sorry for any inconvenience. synodal pathway update 300 delegates from across the island of ireland gathered on saturday in gormanstown, co meath to discern together 35 proposals for action that have emerged in the synodal pathway that the church has been on since 2021. for each proposal, the assembly had four options: highly recommend, recommend, needs more discernment, do not recommend. the bishops now have the responsibility of receiving the discernment of the assembly. as the synodal pathway continues, the working document for the assembly remains a valuable document for all interested in the life of our church and parishes. it not only outlines the 35 proposals but also describes a vision for the church that has emerged through the synodal process. this vision is worth taking the time to read and can be accessed on

leighlinbridge & district active retired: on monday 19th ann moylan will lead another singing session. no meeting on october 26th as it is a bank holiday. living well expo 2026: older people across county carlow are warmly invited to the living well expo 2026 at the mount wolseley hotel, tullow, on wednesday 21 october from 9.30am to 1pm . come along to meet local organisations, find out about services and supports, and discover opportunities to stay active, connected and informed in your community. information will be available on health and wellbeing, community supports, transport, housing, digital skills, social activities and more. free admission. everyone welcome. transport assistance may be available . for further information or to discuss transport options, contact martha jane duggan on
agefriendlycarlow@carlowcoco.ie
